component.name: Canvas Rubric Importer
component.summary: Import CSV Rubrics Into Canvas Directly

description.p: Canvas Rubric Importer is a cross-platform desktop and CLI tool for importing rubrics into Instructure Canvas from CSV files.

ul.li: Generate Canvas-compatible rubrics from a simple CSV template
Upload rubrics to specific courses and assignments
Download existing rubrics from Canvas as CSV for editing or backup
Browse courses and assignments, and preview rubrics before upload
Run either as a GUI application or as a CLI tool

screenshot.caption: Configure Canvas access and import rubrics from CSV
Browse courses and assignments loaded from Canvas
